g.text: Live Stellar Testnet payment · sandbox utility fulfilment · example: Mama buys ₦500 of light (0.34 USDC)
③ buy(): caps + saved meter OK
⑦ token 2636 2054 4059 8275 7802 shown in Mama's chat
USDC moves on Stellar testnet (live today)
If any rule fails at ③ (over the cap, wrong meter, paused), the contract refuses and no USDC moves. Mhasibu's wallet never holds more than one top-up.
